title: Studio Access › Tab visibility: the tab-name input keeps only the first character typed (typing `showcase_app` saves `{"s":"hidden"}`)
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

Each keystroke remounts the row, so focus leaves the input after the first character and the rest is lost. Pasting works.

## Reproduction

1. Access › a permission set › Tab visibility › Add tab › type `showcase_app` › Hidden → draft `tabPermissions: {"s":"hidden"}`; `document.activeElement` is BODY after the first key.

## Expected

The input keeps focus and the full name is stored.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`PermissionAdvancedFacets.tsx` ~749-758: the row React `key` is the tab name, so editing the name remounts the row.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured by the Access QA card.
- Business reason: Tab visibility cannot be authored by typing.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:access`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `tab visibility name input keeps only first character permission set` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 0 hits.
- QA id: A2
